title: Total requests
description: LLM API requests captured on the nginx proxy within the time range (llm-request-body-*; one doc per POST)

title: Total responses
description: response docs in llm-response-body-* within the time range — fewer than requests while streams are in flight or failed before the response was captured

title: Avg request time (s)
description: mean end-to-end request time over the proxy (request_time from the nginx access line, both body indices)

title: Total tokens
description: prompt + completion tokens served in range (usage fields of llm-response-body-*; streams without include_usage report no usage)

title: Latency over time
description: end-to-end request time (nginx request_time) — mean plus p50/p90/p99; long streaming agentic calls dominate the tail

title: Upstream response time by instance
description: time spent in the upstream llama-server instance (upstream_response_time) per upstream_addr ip:port — load-balancing health across 8001-8004

title: Errors (4xx/5xx) over time
description: proxied requests whose upstream returned 4xx/502 (upstream_status >= 400); 200 = healthy

title: Finish reasons over time
description: completion finish_reason of llm-response-body-* — tool_calls = the agent loop requested another round, stop = final answer

title: Request payload size
description: size of the OpenAI-compatible request body (request_body_bytes, llm-request-body-*) — grows with the agentic conversation history

title: Response payload size
description: reconstructed completion size (response_body_bytes) vs bytes actually sent over the wire (body_bytes_sent), llm-response-body-*

title: Context growth (messages)
description: messages per request (messages_count, llm-request-body-*) — the depth of the agentic conversation being replayed to the model

title: Tools per request
description: tools exposed per request (tools_count, llm-request-body-*) — a guardrail signal: the function set sent to the model is expected to stay stable

title: SSE chunks per response
description: SSE events per streamed response (chunk_count, llm-response-body-*; non-streaming responses report 0/none)

title: Completion token distribution
description: per-response completion tokens (usage_completion_tokens) — p50/p90/p99; most of the tokens go into tool-call payloads
